traits.name: Blatant Liar
traits.text: While all divs delight in lying, sepids are compulsive and predictable liars who always do the opposite of what they claim they'll do. If a sepid is ever forced or compelled to tell the truth, they take 4d8 (4d8) mental damage.

traits.name: Attack of Opportunity
traits.text: ⬲ A sepid gains an extra reaction each round that they can use only to make an Attack of Opportunity.

traits.name: Deflecting Lie
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger A creature hits the sepid with a ranged Strike or a ranged spell attack roll Effect The sepid lies in an attempt to divert the attack. They roll a Deception check against the triggering creature's Perception DC. On a success, if the triggering attack roll was a success, it becomes a failure, and if the triggering attack roll was a critical hit, it becomes a normal success.

traits.name: Divine Ritual
traits.text: DC 34; div pact, create undead (no secondary caster required)

traits.name: Rain of Debris
traits.text: ⬺ (divine, evil, evocation); The sepid calls forth a hail of stone, wood, metal, and similar debris in a 40-foot emanation, dealing 10d6 (10d6) bludgeoning damage and 5d6 (5d6) evil damage. Each creature in the area other than the sepid must attempt a basic DC 31 Reflex saving throw. The sepid can't use Rain of Debris again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.
